lede: The most substantive government action this week is Thursday's joint work session where the San Miguel County Planning Commission and Board of County Commissioners sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry practices, oil and gas operations, deep geothermal operations, and condominium plats — no final votes, but this is where the shape of those rules gets decided. In the meantime, the valley is deep into Fourth of July mode, with the parade, drone shows, Rundola, and a full slate of music and community events filling the holiday weekend.

notable.stake: Joint session shapes Land Use Code rules on forestry, oil, gas, and geothermal.
